messages:
Incident Bot: :warning: Alert - elevated 504/timeout rate detected for dedicated-eu (route /v1/chat). Spike started ~13:07 UTC, current error rate ~12%. Auto-escalating to on-call.
Ravi P. (oncall): I'm on it. Assigning SRE + infra. Can someone grab recent autoscaler events and node health?
Nina S. (SRE): Looking. I see an unusual flurry of pod restarts on nodepool eu-dedicated-gpu-burst. Restarts coincide with a recent runtime rollout (runtime-image: rtdb/v2.4.1).
Carlos M. (infra): I pulled kube events — nodes report GPU driver timeouts then pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff. Candidate: driver incompat with new runtime binary.
Ravi P. (oncall): Oof. Do we have a fallback pool that preserves tenant isolation? Need to avoid cross-tenant mixing.
Tanya L. (AM): Which enterprise customers are in the affected nodepool? I should start outreach.
Nina S. (SRE): Affected tenants from routing table: Orchid Therapeutics (dedicated-eu), Bluehaven Insurance (dedicated-eu), Meridian Autos (dedicated-eu - low volume). Orchid is high-touch with an SLA.
Ravi P. (oncall): Tanya draft targeted update for Orchid. We'll route Orchid to the disaster-pool (isolated standby) while we roll back runtime. Carlos, can you spin up the standby and move Orchid there?
Carlos M. (infra): Spinning standby nodes now. Command: `terraform apply -var 'nodepool=eu-standby-gpu'` then `kubectl set node-selector ds/inference nodepool=eu-standby-gpu --namespace=inference` (canary first). ETA 6m for first tenant shift.
Nina S. (SRE): Meanwhile I'll revert runtime to rtdb/v2.4.0 on affected nodepool to stop further crashes. Rolling revert command: `kubectl -n inference set image ds/inference runtime=rtdb:v2.4.0 && kubectl rollout restart ds/inference -l nodepool=eu-dedicated-gpu-burst`
Ravi P. (oncall): Good. Also enable degraded-mode circuit for non-enterprise tenants to reduce load. Policy: `circuit: enable-degraded-priority`
Tanya L. (AM): Draft for Orchid Therapeutics (to send via support channel / email):

```
Orchid Therapeutics team,

We are investigating elevated timeouts impacting your Dedicated EU deployment since ~13:07 UTC. Impact: intermittent timeouts and 504 responses for some inference requests. Current action: we are routing your traffic to an isolated standby pool and rolling back a recent runtime deployment to stabilize. Expected impact during mitigation: brief reconnections and some additional latency while we switch pools (~5-20 minutes). No data leakage; tenant isolation is preserved.

We'll follow up with a full incident summary and RCA. Your TAM (Tanya L.) is available on the channel and will coordinate any account-level requests.
```

Tanya L. (AM): Sending now. Pasting sent confirmation.
CS Ops Bot: Notification sent to Orchid Therapeutics (ticket#OR-8132). TAM notified.
QA Bot: Canary verification started for Orchid traffic on standby pool. Running smoke: 100 requests @5 qps.
Nina S. (SRE): Revert started. One pod updated and stable for 7m, runtime crash count dropped to 0 on that host.
Carlos M. (infra): Standby pool ready, shifting Orchid traffic. Observed 92% of Orchid requests hitting standby within 3m.
Ravi P. (oncall): Any visible degradation left for Orchid after shift?
QA Bot: Canary smoke passed: 100/100 success, median latency +70ms. No 5xx observed.
Tanya L. (AM): Orchid replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick mitigation. Please share an ETA for full restore to their original dedicated pool."
Nina S. (SRE): ETA: once all nodes are on v2.4.0 and observed healthy for 10m we can shift them back. Estimated 25-40 minutes due to rollout and validation.
Ravi P. (oncall): Draft status page update (public-safe wording):

```
Status: Investigating -> Partial service disruption affecting some Dedicated EU customers
Impact: Some customers on dedicated-eu may experience intermittent timeouts or 504 responses for chat/inference requests. We're reverting a recent runtime deployment and routing impacted tenants to an isolated standby pool while we stabilize. Affected customers on our internal routing: Orchid Therapeutics, Bluehaven Insurance, Meridian Autos (partial). We expect mitigation to complete within 30-45 minutes. No customer data was exposed.
```

Tanya L. (AM): Added CS-friendly internal blurb for AEs/TAMs:

```
Quick update for customer-facing teams: We're mitigating a runtime regression that caused GPU driver incompatibilities on a subset of Dedicated EU nodes. Orchid Therapeutics and Bluehaven Insurance were affected; Orchid traffic has been shifted to an isolated standby pool. Please advise customers that tenant isolation was preserved and a full RCA will be provided. For urgent account concerns contact TAM Tanya L.
```

Ravi P. (oncall): Good. Please avoid technical deep-dives in public posts. Keep it high level.
Carlos M. (infra): Revert completed across nodepool; monitoring node stability. Some nodes still show transient driver warnings but no pod crashes for 15m.
Nina S. (SRE): Running validation tests across workloads. No errors for 20m on nodes running v2.4.0.
Ravi P. (oncall): Plan: keep Orchid on standby until we have 30m of stable signals post-revert, then schedule controlled move-back with CSM notification. Postmortem assigned to runtime & infra.
CS Ops Bot: Incident state -> Mitigated. Created follow-up ticket PM-9470 assigned to runtime (Nina S.) and infra (Carlos M.).
Tanya L. (AM): I've scheduled a 30-min customer sync with Orchid for 14:30 UTC to walk through steps and offer any compensation if required.
Ravi P. (oncall): Handoff note to next oncall: root cause likely runtime-driver compatibility introduced in rtdb/v2.4.1; actions taken: rollback, shifted impacted tenants to isolated standby, added guard: `block-image-rollout-if-driver-warn=true`. Please monitor GPU driver warnings and routing error rate for next 6h. Open follow-up to add an automated preflight test for runtime-driver combos.
Nina S. (SRE): Adding runbook item: before runtime rollouts to gpu nodepools, run `driver-compat-check.sh` and require green.
Ravi P. (oncall): Thanks team. Closing thread after PM ticket created and customer ack received.
CS Ops Bot: PM ticket PM-9470 created. Orchid acknowledged (OR-8132). End of thread.
